exposure: Safe Motherhood Initiative (SMI) guidelines for VTE prophylaxis
outcome: Prescribing rates of mechanical and pharmacologic VTE prophylaxis
Administration rates of pharmacologic VTE prophylaxis
cohort: 616 pregnant women undergoing cesarean section at a large academic medical center in Sacramento, California, USA
finding: Despite a large population of cesarean section patients meeting the SMI criteria for pharmacologic VTE prophylaxis, prescribing rates remained low (4.71%) while the 6-week postpartum VTE incidence was 0.49%.
